title: Token-level observability: enhanced metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Ava Thompson
description: Add token-level metrics and enhanced tracing hooks, wire up Grafana dashboards, and tune alerts to reduce noise while surfacing cost/latency regressions. Motivation: customers require per-token cost and latency breakdowns for pricing and perf debugging; existing metrics were coarse-grained by request only and alerts generated noisy incident churn. This change introduces: 1) new Prometheus metrics prefixed with redwood_token_{cost,latency,count} aggregated by model, route and request_type; 2) tracing spans to capture token generation hotpaths and KV cache hits/misses; 3) dashboard panels for token-cost breakdown, tail-latency by token position, and batching efficiency; 4) alert tuning to move from 95th-percentile request latency alerts to token-level anomaly scoring and composite alerts that suppress noise. Implementation notes: added sampling-safe counters, bounded tag cardinality via model/route sanitization, and a lightweight rollup job for hourly token-cost aggregates to support long-retention dashboards. Backwards compatibility: metric names added with clear deprecation plan and feature flag to enable tracing in high-volume fleets. Includes unit and integration tests plus dashboard JSON and alert rule updates.
